ns2:course.label: Environmental Geology
ns2:course.description: Increases student understanding of environmental issues of water supply and pollution, waste disposal, energy, environmental health, global change, and land evaluation and use by emphasizing the role of geology and its relationships to human activities. Course requires a one-day field trip and field trip fee. Same as ENVS 380. Prerequisite: CHEM 102 and CHEM 103; and GEOL 100 and GEOL 110, or GEOL 101, GEOL 103, GEOL 104, GEOL 107, or GEOL 111; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as ENVS 380. Prerequisite: CHEM 102 and CHEM 103; and GEOL 100 and GEOL 110, or GEOL 101, GEOL 103, GEOL 104, GEOL 107, or GEOL 111; or consent of instructor.
